name: PT Surya Fajar Capital Tbk
summary: PT Surya Fajar Capital Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial consulting and investment services in Indonesia. It operates through five segments: Brokerage and Underwriter; Financial Technology Peer to Peer Lending; Electronic Payment Services; Technology with Securities Crowdfunding; and Consultancy Services. The company provides financial advisory services on strategic transactions, such as mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, and restructuring in the initial public offering (IPO) preparation; various financial services, including buying and selling of stock and bond, stock and bond IPOs, rights issues, and medium-term notes; macro and MSME financing activities through …
